newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIAN GOVERNMENT'S AGENDA ON WEDNESDAY.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIAN GOVERNMENT'S AGENDA ON WEDNESDAY.

text.p: The Romanian government on Wednesday adopted bill to ratify the Romanian-Hungarian treaty signed on Monday, a cabinet official said.
"The government hopes that parliament will ratify this important document before the end of its present session," government spokesman Ioan Rosca told a news conference,
Other issues on government agenda on Wednesday included:
* The cabinet will hold an extraordinary meeting on Friday to decide on fourth quarter wage and pensions indexations;
* Report by head of technical secretariat in charge with organising general election, saying 67 percent of voters' cards were ready but only 14 percent have been mailed so far;
* Agriculture Minister Alexandru Lapusan's report on autumn farming campaign, saying delays in fuel deliveries would be recovered in the next two weeks;
* Government decided to grant soft loans to state companies to set up 1996 food and grain crop seeds stocks;
* Draft law to set up National Agency for Labour Placement and Reconversion which would also manage unemployment funds.
* Government asked parliament to observe international standards during debates on new penal code, especially on article regarding homosexual relations. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
